effective_tg_water_diagnostic.interpretation: The Tg_water Fox would require to reproduce the data is BELOW even the glassy-water convention, i.e. absorbed water plasticizes this epoxy network MORE strongly than a generic free-volume diluent -- consistent with H-bond-network disruption and bound/clustered water in the cured amine-epoxy.

empirical_plasticization_slope.definition: dTg/d(wt% water), calibrated on the single measured saturation point

hypothesis_test.H0_parameter_free_magnitude_accurate: a parameter-free Fox/Kelley-Bueche prediction reproduces the measured wet-Tg depression within the measured band
hypothesis_test.detail: best parameter-free depression 17.26 C vs measured band [22.90, 27.90] C

illustrative_in_scope_deployment.caveat: FIRST-ORDER SCREEN ONLY. Empirical slope transferred from a DIFFERENT in-scope DGEBA-amine system; dry Tg and uptake are cross-source pairs from signed in-tree receipts; NOT a measurement and NOT validated for these systems. Shown to size the marine barrier-softening risk, not to claim it.

marine_relevance: A ~25 C wet-Tg drop at only 3 wt% seawater uptake means a nominally 89 C-Tg marine primer can fall to ~64 C wet -- still above service temperature, but the margin erodes fast for lower-Tg aliphatic-amine systems. This engine turns dry-Tg + uptake (both already predicted in-tree) into a wet-service-margin screen.
phase0_reconciliation_redteam: Re-verified live this run: all 29 module benchmark-locks carry scientific_success_required_for_phase0=false and negative_result_authority=AUDIT_ONLY; 0/29 modules are scientific_readiness=VALIDATED. 'FULL Phase-0' is a GOVERNANCE state, not a validated-science state. This increment adds real, non-circular science under AUDIT_ONLY and changes no authority or count.
target_capability: Predict the water-saturated (wet) glass-transition temperature of a cured two-part DGEBA-amine marine coating from its dry Tg and equilibrium water uptake -- the barrier-softening property that governs osmotic blistering and cathodic-disbondment kinetics under seawater immersion.
theory: Fox (1956) mass-fraction Tg rule and Kelley & Bueche (1961) free-volume polymer-diluent Tg model, with absorbed water as the plasticizing diluent. Glass-transition of water taken from the literature (glassy 136 K; liquid-like 277 K). No parameter is fitted to the measured wet Tg.
verdict: WET_TG_PLASTICIZATION_ENGINE_ESTABLISHED :: DIRECTION_VALIDATED (all engines predict the correct Tg drop) :: PARAMETER_FREE_MAGNITUDE_REFUTED (naive Fox/Kelley-Bueche UNDER-predict the measured depression by ~1.5x-8x). TRUSTWORTHY OUTPUT = the empirical plasticization slope 8.5 C per wt%% water (literature-consistent); a-priori magnitude is NOT trustworthy for marine barrier-softening assessment and must be empirically calibrated.
